name: Goals
overview: Scripture teaches that setting and pursuing goals should be grounded in a committed relationship with God, trusting Him to bring plans to fruition as seen in Psalms 37:5. Wisdom in numbering our days encourages thoughtful and diligent planning rather than haste, reflected in Proverbs 21:5. Prioritizing God's kingdom above all else ensures that our goals align with His righteousness, promising that all other needs will be met according to Matthew 6:33. God’s presence and strength, assured in Isaiah 41:10, empower believers to face challenges confidently while pursuing their God-honoring dreams.
